create_trainer: create a Trainer instance with a specified evaluation frequency for VIP model training
run_trainer_update: run the trainer update method to compute LP and VIP losses on a batch of images and rewards
test_trainer_eval: test the trainer update method in evaluation mode without performing backpropagation
refactor_trainer_loss: refactor the trainer update to support configurable negative sampling for VIP loss computation
review_trainer_metrics: review the trainer update method that returns timing metrics and loss values including l1loss, l2loss, and vip_loss
